image_description: A close-up view of a large grey whale surfacing next to a small blue boat. The whale's head and rostrum are visible, showing mottled dark grey skin with lighter patches (barnacles/callosities). The body extends into the water. A portion of a blue inflatable or rigid-hulled boat is in the foreground on the right. There is illegible text overlay at the bottom.

The rostrum appears somewhat blunt but the 'arched' nature is hard to confirm definitively. Marking false due to lack of clear visibility of key diagnostic features (blowholes).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
